svg.title: doppler
svg.desc: λobs/λrest = sqrt((1+β)/(1−β)), β=v/c. The approximation Δλ/λ ≈ v/c applies for |v| ≪ c; compare its error in the readout. Hypothetical reference lines at 499.7, 500.0 and 500.3 nm are not element identifications. Only longitudinal motion is modeled. Sources: https://physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants/Table/allascii.txt https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/poet_calculations.html
